transformations: Encoded the native 40-byte syscall reply as hexadecimal plus newline.
Replaced only the last 16 bytes, the private volume UUID, with a synthetic UUID; retained the native length and returned attribute words.
Original stdout hash binds the raw 40 bytes before hexadecimal encoding.
limitations: Single successful interactive read from an existing directory descriptor; not recovery across a reboot or replacement volume.
The synthetic UUID proves decoder placement, never the original volume identity.
The captured request hex was 050000000000008000000480000000000000000000000000 and flags were 12.
